results.title: Switzerland’s First Retail Bitcoin ETF Gets Regulatory Green Light
results.description: Switzerland has approved its first retail spot bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF), opening a regulated investment vehicle previously unavailable to ordinary investors under Swiss fund law. Announced on Tuesday, the decision includes an exemption from standard diversification requirements, allowing a public fund to concentrate directly on bitcoin. results.title: Her Hospital’s 403(b) Will Charge a 63-Year-Old Nurse $31,000 to Leave. The Same Money in a 401(k) Would Have Walked Out for Free
results.description: A hospital nurse discovered that leaving her retirement plan comes with a price tag most workers never see until it's too late. Whether paying it makes sense depends on a calculation her plan administrator has no reason to share with her.
